profile.name: Pritam
profile.shortBio: I build systems from bare metal to inference. Firmware, ROS stacks, edge ML -- the full hardware-software stack.

about.fullBio:
I work at the intersection of embedded systems and machine learning. Writing firmware in Embedded C, building ROS navigation stacks, deploying neural nets on constrained hardware -- I take systems from schematic to real-world inference.

Current focus: robotic perception and embedded AI acceleration. I also grind competitive programming to keep algorithmic thinking sharp, because building smart hardware requires both intuition and rigor.

experience.title: Embedded Application Engineer
description: Firmware development in Embedded C for production MCUs and PCBs.
Hardware prototyping with CuPID development boards for IoT and automation.
PCB design and layout review focused on signal integrity and performance.
Cross-layer embedded system integration -- hardware to application firmware.
